text: {"lessons":["My account has declined overall, but the later rebound shows why I should not treat a short-term loss as a reliable signal about what comes next.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should avoid panic-selling and make decisions based on my goals and risk tolerance, not the discomfort of a temporary drawdown.","Doing nothing has avoided unnecessary trading, but I should still review my portfolio periodically and make deliberate changes if my plan or circumstances call for them."]}
